biggest_catch: Both you and your friend only qualify after the referred customer keeps active service for at least 10 days (30 days in East/Midwest); month-to-month plans and commercial entities are excluded.
catches: New customer must sign up for a term plan using a current customer's referral code.
Referred customer must keep active service at least 10 days (Texas) or 30 days (East/Midwest).
Texas: bill credits applied within two billing cycles; Midwest/Northeast: gift cards (new customer after 30 days, referrer after 90 days of referred service).
Rewards limited to eligible residential customers; exclude month-to-month plans, sales agents, mass/automated referrals.
Commercial entities not eligible; program unavailable in CT, MA, NY for Midwest/Northeast.
Rewards are the current offer amount ($50 at verification) and Direct Energy may change the amount without notice.
Texas bill credits apply only to the kWh usage portion of the bill, not taxes/fees.
Participants earning ~$550+/year in gift cards may need to submit a W-9.
Framed as savings on planned energy spending, never income.

c1.evidence: Provider is Direct Energy, retail electricity/gas supplier (directenergy.com); page is their own Refer a Friend Referral Program with full terms of use.

c2.evidence: Official program page opened live 2026-09-23 at directenergy.com; page states the current $50 reward with active-service qualification rules; terms of use updated and accessible.

c3.evidence: 'Your electricity service must be active for at least 10 days (30 days in East/Midwest) to qualify for the $50' and 'Once that happens, the rewards for both the new customer and the current customer will be processed.'

c4.evidence: Both the new customer and the current (referring) customer receive the $50 reward under the same program; no customer-only restriction.

eligibility: Referrer: current Direct Energy residential customer with an active term plan. Referred: new Direct Energy customer signing up for a term plan (not month-to-month) with the referral code; active service 10 days (Texas) / 30 days (East/Midwest); unavailable in CT, MA, NY for Midwest/Northeast.
notes: Verified 2026-09-23 from Direct Energy's official US refer-a-friend page and terms of use. $50 per side (Texas: bill credit; East/Midwest: gift card). Framed as savings on planned energy spending.
numeric_basis: payout from official program page ($50 reward each side for new + referring customer; Texas = bill credit, East/Midwest = gift card); time: share/use referral code + signup est. 5-15 min active
payout_quote: Your electricity service must be active for at least 10 days (30 days in East/Midwest) to qualify for the $50... Once that happens, the rewards for both the new customer and the current customer will be processed.
payout_value_note: $50 per side per qualifying referral (Texas: bill credit; East/Midwest: gift card); reward amount is Direct Energy's current offer and may change without notice.

s1.note: Concrete payout $50 each side stated on official program page and terms of use.

s2.note: Conditions stated: term plan, referral code, active service periods, exclusions (month-to-month, commercial, CT/MA/NY).

s6.note: No inflated conversion; $50 face value used.

steps: Be a current Direct Energy residential customer with an active term plan.
Share your referral code with a friend (found in your account manager).
Friend signs up for a Direct Energy term plan using your referral code.
Friend keeps active electricity service for at least 10 days (Texas) or 30 days (East/Midwest).
$50 reward processed to both: Texas bill credit within two billing cycles; East/Midwest gift card.
timing: Rewards processed after the referred customer completes 10 days (Texas) or 30 days (East/Midwest) of active service; Texas bill credits within two billing cycles.
